props.title: Will Ramzan Kadyrov remain as Head of the Chechen Republic until December 1, 2025?
props.shortTitle: Ramzan Kadyrov still Head of Chechnya on Dec. 1?
props.details:
Resolution:: The question will resolve based on credible news sources. If Ramzan Kadyrov remains as Head of Chechnya by December 1, it will be resolved as "yes".

Background:: Ramzan Kadyrov, who is the Head of the Russian region Chechnya, has health problems according to media reports. It was also recently reported that Kadyrov has fallen out of favor with Putin due to the fact that he maintained contacts with Middle Eastern countries independently of Moscow. Ramzan Kadyrov has led Chechnya for many years and is one of Putin's important allies, controlling tens of thousands of armed Chechens, who are formally Russian military and police.
